cohort: Six preterm infants born to mothers with COVID-19 admitted to Tongji Hospital between January 23 and March 19, 2020
finding: With appropriate management, including expedited delivery protocols, less invasive treatment, and active infection precautions, COVID-19 infection in mothers had a limited impact on preterm delivery and short-term neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: One late preterm infant was delivered early due to maternal dyspnea from COVID-19, while five infants were delivered by Caesarean section.
